name: ecom-microservices
description: E-commerce microservice demo — Node/TypeScript services behind an API gateway with a Next.js + shadcn/ui storefront

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@ecom/shared && npm run build --workspace=@ecom/service-kit
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,product,order,web -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue "npm:dev:gateway" "npm:dev:auth" "npm:dev:product" "npm:dev:order" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
